name: split-beat-he-plugin
description: Configure, calibrate and diagnose Split-Beat HE keyboards connected to this computer.

interface.longDescription: Use the local USB connection to tune Hall keys, map inputs and inspect sensor behavior.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read my connected Split-Beat HE keyboard’s current mapping and saved/unsaved state, then guide me using its mapped key names and show its calibration and rapid-trigger settings.
